arjun: Heads up — enabled activation checkpointing on the 32B TP=2 PP=8 nightly run and seeing a ~18-22% tail latency regression + throughput drop on long-context (4k). Profiling attached.

maria: @arjun which checkpointing strategy did you use? full remat or selective layers?

arjun: remat=full per-block (recompute_every=1). microbatch=4, seq_len=4096, KV caching on across PP stages. Baseline (no checkpoint): 4100 tok/s. with checkpointing: 3250 tok/s.

kevin: That magnitude smells like comm amplification. Recompute means extra forward passes which re-emit KV updates and can trigger more frequent all-reduces. Any NCCL traces?

arjun: yeah captured per-rank NCCL timelines — trimmed excerpt below:

```
[rank0] allreduce 1: start 123.45ms end 200.30ms (+76.85ms)
[rank0] forward block 12 recompute: 200.30ms - 260.12ms
[pipeline] idle gap during allreduce ~40ms
```

lucy: Do we still overlap KV all-reduce with compute? Our kernel scheduler tries to schedule async allreduces but recompute inserts extra blocking ops, maybe the scheduler assumes a single forward pass. :thinking: 

kevin: Exactly — two things to watch: 1) recompute doubles forward op count so we need to amortize comms across passes; 2) current KV restore does synchronous memcpy per recompute, which kills overlap.

arjun: I repro'd with a small change: deferred KV restore + non-blocking allreduce -> tail latency drops to ~8% above baseline. Repro command I used:

```
export RL_RUNTIME_DEBUG=1
rl-run --model=redwood-32b --tp=2 --pp=8 --microbatch=4 --recompute=full \
  --kv-restore=deferred --noreduce-blocking
```

maria: :thumbsup: can you attach the full flamegraph and callcounts? Also which kernels moved — cuBLAS vs cutlass?

arjun: Flamegraph uploaded to s3://perf/1728123456/flame.svg. Callcount summary: remat increases small-GEMM callcount ~1.9x; kernel selector moved some GEMMs from cuBLAS to cutlass int8 path because of smaller mat shapes during recompute; that interaction increases kernel latency variance and makes hiding NCCL harder.

lucy: Proposed action items: (1) make KV restore async and coalesce restores across microbatches, (2) update scheduler to prefer longer compute kernels during active allreduce windows so compute hides comm, (3) add perf regression test which toggles recompute strategies for TP/PP shapes.

kevin: I'll prototype non-blocking KV restore + deferred memcpy. We should also update Optimize to include a recompute tradeoff table by (TP, PP, seq_len, microbatch).

perf-bot: Perf test queued: 1728123456/checkpoint-recompute-smoke — results will be posted to #eng-runtime when ready.

arjun: Thanks — I'll add a short repro script and upload full logs to the S3 folder in this thread.
